facts.text: Admitted students who submit the FAFSA are eligible for at least $57,000 in scholarships toward their education through the Siena Guarantee.

sources.title: The Siena Guarantee | Siena University
sources.quote: All you have to do is get admitted and send Siena your FAFSA to be eligible for at least $57,000 toward your education.

facts.text: Siena guarantees that students will earn their bachelor's degree in four years or the institution will pay for the rest.

sources.title: The Siena Guarantee | Siena University
sources.quote: Earn your bachelor's degree in four years or we will pay for the rest.

facts.text: Siena's mission is informed by the Franciscan tradition alongside 21 other Franciscan colleges and universities in the United States.

sources.title: Catholic Franciscan Tradition | Siena University
sources.quote: It continues to inform the mission of Siena College and 21 other Franciscan colleges and universities in the United States.
